brief: How to set boundaries without losing the people you love.

slots.title: BOUNDARIES KEEP THE PEOPLE YOU LOVE CLOSE
KNOW YOUR LIMITS FIRST
slots.body: You cannot pour from an empty cup. Name your limits before resentment names them for you. Clarity protects the relationship.

slots.title: USE CLEAR DIRECT WORDS
slots.body: Vague hints create confusion and hurt. State what you need with calm honesty. Directness is a form of respect.

slots.title: NO IS A FULL SENTENCE
slots.body: Every time you backslide, you teach others to ignore your words. Consistency builds trust faster than perfection ever could.

slots.title: DISCOMFORT IS NOT DESTRUCTION
slots.body: Someone being upset with your boundary does not mean you were cruel. It means you finally told the truth. Love survives honesty.

slots.title: YOUR GUILT IS A LIAR
slots.body: You were trained to feel selfish for having needs. That feeling is conditioning, not fact. Keep the boundary anyway.

slots.title: LOVE NEEDS ROOM TO BREATHE
slots.body: People who truly love you will adjust. Those who leave were already asking too much. Boundaries reveal who is real.

slots.headline: DRAW THE LINE TODAY
slots.body: Which relationship needs your first honest boundary? Comment below and claim it.
